title: Local lifts detect zero on the categorical local image
statement: For a scheme X, a Grothendieck abelian category A, a morphism p:F→G of A-valued small-etale sheaves, an etale object W, and maps x:B→G(W), g:B→T [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], suppose x factors through localImage(p,W) [def-weil-pbc-grothendieck-etale-local-image]. If every π:B′→B for which πx lifts through p on a covering sieve satisfies πg=0, then g=0. No epimorphism assumption on p or qcqs assumption on W is needed.

source.place: Tag 00WL (section-sheaves-injective), image subsheaf argument for epimorphisms. The construction using epimorphic source maps is an agent-written extension to arbitrary Grothendieck abelian coefficients.

proof.text: Write localImage as its small directed union and pull back along x. The factoring assumption and the directed-pullback theorem make the union of these inverse images equal to B.

For each member S, pull its witnessing epimorphism P→S back along the map from the inverse-image subobject to S. The composite to B has the covering sieve and local lifts inherited from P. The hypothesis kills its composite with g; cancel the pulled-back epimorphism.
Every inverse-image subobject now lies in ker(g). Their union is top, so ker(g)=top and g=0.

lean.statement: theorem eq_zero_of_factors_localImage {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A} (p : F ⟶ G) (W : X.Etale) (B T : A) (x : B ⟶ G.obj.obj (op W)) (g : B ⟶ T) (hx : (localImage p W).Factors x) (hkill : ∀ (B' : A) (π : B' ⟶ B) (R : Sieve W), R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W → (∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), R f → ∃ l : B' ⟶ F.obj.obj (op Z), l ≫ p.hom.app (op Z) = π ≫ x ≫ G.obj.map f.op) → π ≫ g = 0) : g = 0
